capabilities: scrape trending items from 25+ sources (GitHub, Hacker News, Medium, Zhihu, arXiv, etc.)
score and summarize each item with an AI model
filter content by selected focus areas and a score threshold
write a daily digest markdown file with frontmatter, scores, and tags
schedule daily runs and merge new items into the same day's file
extras: Bilingual English/Chinese README. Changing tracked X/Twitter accounts requires editing the accounts array in main.js, since there is no setting for it.
problem: Keeping up with trending content across GitHub, Hacker News, Medium, Zhihu and many other sites requires manually visiting each one every day.

relations.evidence: Works with Anthropic API, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or any Anthropic Messages API-compatible endpoint.
Aggregates AI/tech accounts via Nitter RSS (no API key needed)

requires.name: Claude-compatible API key (Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, or any Anthropic Messages API-compatible provider)

summary: Aggregator that scrapes trending pages from 25+ sources, scores each item with AI, and writes a daily digest markdown file to the vault.
